referents.why: 'their secret arts': the magicians (w4), third plural.
'they brought up the frogs': the magicians, the subject of the wayyiqtol.

links.why: then runs within a verse only; across the verse boundary it is not used.
'did thus' (ken) with a named subject not carrying out a command: the magicians do the same as Aaron's deed just done, after the latest command. Imitation, not fulfilment.
wayyiqtol continues the narrative: they did thus, then brought up the frogs.
